title: Publishing Workflow Spec Compiler
description: Compiles the content publishing workflow specification. Enforces: all required workflow states present, no unreachable states, published state has an archive/unpublish transition, no direct draft-to-published bypass, terminal states exist, and role-based transition rules are valid.

error_codes.PWS001: publishing-workflow-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: states[], transitions[], roles[]
error_codes.PWS002: Workflow missing required states — must include at minimum: draft, review, published, archived
error_codes.PWS003: Published state has no archive or unpublish transition — published content must have an exit path
error_codes.PWS004: Unreachable state detected — every declared state must be reachable from at least one transition
error_codes.PWS005: No terminal state defined — at least one state must have no outbound transitions (e.g., archived, deleted)
error_codes.PWS006: Transition role is undefined — every transition must reference a role declared in the roles list
error_codes.PWS007: Direct draft-to-published transition exists — content must pass through review before publishing
